description: Simulate an architecture (archsim format) with the Architecture Simulator's engine: steady-state throughput, p50/p95 RESPONSE latency (it ends at the first queue) and PROCESSING latency, availability, bottleneck, infrastructure cost per hour, per-queue lag / "full in N s" / silently lost messages, per-node utilization, and the Report's findings. Optionally also runs a timed phase with a scenario (peak, DDoS, LLM outage) and reports the worst of it. Deterministic; nothing leaves the machine.

aiReqPerSec.description: Requests/s entering through AI sources (nodes with no input that are not clients). Default 0.

phase.description: Timed phase after steady state (e.g. {"seconds":60,"scenario":{"loadMult":6}}): queues fill, autoscaling lags (~60 s by default).

attackRate.description: Attack rps injected at the clients (DDoS).

downKinds.description: Take down every node of these kinds (e.g. ["ai_router"]).

name: archsim_simulate
